selection: For each case, consider only converged 10/12-step targets with a verified entangling fit >=.98. Prefer full endpoint, then 12 steps, then shallowest CZ depth meeting threshold, then fidelity. Product-only is a separate control. If no target qualifies, run no new hardware for that case. Select entirely from new classical results; previous hardware outcomes are known but not used in this ranking.
inference: Each selected case has four primary contrasts: AQC versus product/uncompressed, separately for standalone preparation and prefixed QAOA. Feasibility and within-5%-optimum events use two-sided Fisher tests, one Holm family over all selected cases and contrasts. Two fresh randomized measurement blocks; no hardware selection or tuning.
scope: Exploratory step-resolution and ansatz-depth sweep on four previously studied instances, not a new instance-generalization test. The complete target Hamiltonian is retained. Three starts per depth: one layerwise extension of the best preceding fit, two random starts. All targets, failures, fitting costs and original results are retained. No lower-endpoint fallback. No quantum-advantage claim. Resource amendment requested by user after excessive RAM use: one isolated process per target or fit, hard 4 GiB address-space cap, 3 GiB RSS watchdog and 12 GiB system reserve. Completed old fits may be reused with original provenance; failures are retained. No unconstrained process may resume.
